rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday way to say that something is next to or beside something else.

example.english: That cha chaan teng is next to the cinema.
example.traditional: 間茶餐廳就喺戲院旁邊。
example.jyutping: gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 zau6 hai2 hei3 jyun2 pong4 bin1

rows.note: Pick this colloquial wording when stressing that someone or something is immediately alongside or next door to A.

example.english: Ming’s flat is next to my home.
example.traditional: 阿明間屋就喺我屋企隔籬。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 gaan1 uk1 zau6 hai2 ngo5 uk1 kei2 gaak3 lei4

rows.note: Use this when describing the physical side of something, especially when the location is clearly alongside it.

example.english: The bicycle is next to the entrance.
example.traditional: 部單車擺咗喺門口側邊。
example.jyutping: bou6 daan1 ce1 baai2 zo2 hai2 mun4 hau2 zak1 bin1
